worked_example.problem: A fish pond near Bafoussam has water, mud, sunlight, water plants, frogs and small fish. Sort these into living and non-living components.
steps: Living things grow, feed and reproduce: water plants, frogs and small fish.
Non-living components: water, mud (soil) and sunlight.
Together they form an ecosystem: the fish need the plants, and the plants need sunlight and water.
worked_example.answer: Living: water plants, frogs, small fish. Non-living: water, mud, sunlight.

cards.idea: The natural environment is everything around us that is not made by people: land, water, air, plants and animals.
example: A river is natural. A bridge over it is built by people.

check.prompt: Which of these is part of the natural environment?

wrong.explain: Market stalls are made by people.

cards.idea: The environment has living (biotic) components, such as plants and animals, and non-living (abiotic) ones, such as air, water and soil.
example: A goat is living; the grass it eats is living; the rain that falls on the grass is non-living.

cards.idea: The Earth has four spheres: lithosphere (rocks and soil), hydrosphere (water), atmosphere (air) and biosphere (living things).
example: Lake Chad is part of the hydrosphere; Mount Cameroon is part of the lithosphere.

cards.idea: An ecosystem is living things and their surroundings in one place, depending on each other. In a food chain, energy passes from plants to animals.
example: Grass → grasshopper → frog → snake. Grass is the producer.

questions.prompt: Sort these: living or non-living components of the environment?
Match each sphere with what it is made of.
In the food chain {c.a} → {c.b} → {c.c} → {c.d}, which is the producer?

misconceptions.explain: That is an animal: a consumer. The producer is the green plant at the start of the chain.

solution: The producer makes its own food using sunlight: the green plant.
It comes first in the chain: {answer}.

questions.prompt: Put this food chain in order, starting with the producer.

right.text: a pond with its plants, fish and frogs

wrong.explain: One animal alone is not an ecosystem: an ecosystem is many living things with their surroundings.
That is a food, not a community of living things with their surroundings.
A rock alone is a non-living thing, not an ecosystem.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: Soil and water are non-living components of the environment.
The hydrosphere is all the water on the Earth.

wrong.text: The atmosphere is made of rocks and soil.
wrong.explain: Rocks and soil are the lithosphere; the atmosphere is the air.

wrong.text: Animals are producers in a food chain.
